# truenas_iscsi_portal (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS iSCSI portal by comment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comment` (String) Comment used to look up the portal.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric iSCSI portal ID.
- `listen` (Attributes List) List of IP/port pairs the portal listens on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listen))
- `tag` (Number) Portal group tag assigned by TrueNAS.

<a id="nestedatt--listen"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listen`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String)
- `port` (Number)
